title: April Fools Update

items: Civil War has been added with new content!
New mercenaries for hire in civil war
New Equipments!
Disposable anti-tank launcher weapons
Grenades has been reworked
Changing your perks and augments outside of intermission now triggers a respawn, and a subsequent stacking of respawn time if you do it repeatedly. This does not count towards your deaths.
Huysven infantry speed has been halved
CORE gets +5k on civil war and DIV, GATE gets +5k on DIV
The base has removed the balcony, with an upcoming base changes in the future.
Fixed the horrendous fog on the last wave on Deluge
Cypher (Deluge)
Rest (Healing)
Slightly reduced the health threshold that he can use it at so he isn't wasting as much of it
Cancel early if he's already at full healthCancel early if he finds that he's taking more damage than healing (only for the enemy version)
Allied Cypher should attempt using it more often when sitting at the base
Chase-down (Charge)
Reduced the amount of drift reduction in Impossible mode so it's less of a jump compared to Revenge (Bri'ish mode still has the current one)
Arm Kanone
Slightly nerfed damage
RPG, Arm Kanone, RPG Ranger
Doubled projecticle speed. (240 → 480)
This is still ridiculously low compared to most other enemy projectiles
Rocketractor:
Now fires inaccurate rockets instead of missiles
Restored Eagle Hunter's 2x damage against aerial targets from its pre-rework version
Since allied tanks now move closer to the front, they now have 50% more max HP
Lion Ace now has 80k HP
Allied tanks now prefer longer engagement ranges the more damaged they are
Tanks has been adjusted to improve performace (Look into the trello for information about it)
Doubled allied (RDF) Invictus' panzerfaust projectile speed, also applied for legion XII sipahi
Fixed Solothurn S-18 not getting affected by Blast Radius modifier
Fixed Potassium Enforcer not getting affected by Blast Radius modifier, increased the base value from 45 to 80
Kyths RPG buffed
Blast Radius: 25 -> 60
Explosive Damage Ratio: 15% -> 25%
Fixed a bug concerning CK1 causing it to not deal DMG
Fixed/buffed XIV Armor back to +15 Stamina instead of +10
Certain armor attachments (like Advanced Ballistic Optics) will now reset your character to properly update the stats

Scraps capture bonus down to 10 per tier The base bonus for capturing tanks is now dependent on their supplies requirement. You will instead get 30% of the supplies required as the coins bonus. For example capturing a ZAC will yield 30 coins since it requires 100 supplies. An imperial destroyer yields 90.
Tier 3 Landmines now require 150 supplies to detonate
Fixed all tank MG
Fixed wrench not being able to “repair” destroyed allied tanks with the main function being to reduce their cooldown. Updated the tooltip to reflect this
Fixed being able to capture tanks not part of the wave
Fixed Joe's gas grenade not having a noise that sounds like gas is releasing
Fixed a Network owner shenanigans with the NPCs which may feel more awkward to fight at first especially cypher

dev_comment: To view the april fools stuff, refer to the trello please

title: The Unexpected QoL Update!
dev_comment: I am on my supposed break, so let me just release a lil calm update on my SUPPOSED break…

items: The new system allows the medkits to be on its own slot, with a keybind attached
Upon healing, it will auto-equip the last weapon used (So you don't have to struggle on reequipping your weapons)
Medkits now accurately shows the cooldown bar and time
Also has an indicator whether the healing effect is in place or not (the little [+] icon)

Specifically for melee players, but for: This makes it so the keybind allows you to heal yourself INSTANTLY, without the need of pressing again to heal yourself
However, the trade-off is that you won't be able to heal OTHERS with the feature on.

items: Mobile players, you will need to double tap to either equip or insta-heal
Console players, you will need to press (Y, TRIANGLE) to insta-heal or equip. (If the intermission button is visible, it won't do nothing to avoid double Y usages)
Additionally for console players, you will automatically have insta-heal as the equip option is a little janky for console.

Those who wish to use wrench or ARE engineer gamers, on PC. The keybind will switch from E to R (YES i know R is for reload but it gets overridden so don't worry...). To avoid accidentally equipping the medkit/healing.

Added a new role: THE FLAG BEARER/CAPTAIN (Totally not to advertise the UGC item). This does nothing but gives a singular person the flag to roleplay as the captain or something. Basically u have more aura
Accommodated the ultrakit to the new medkit system
Frog Squads have a circle marker above them to easily locate them (Only visible for those in the squad)

(IMPORTANT) Fixed a bug where the first squad member to escape would receive all rewards, and the remaining members still inside the sewers OR outside of the sewers would be force-kicked despite being alive and in the process of escaping. This also caused the game to progress immediately after the first escape rather than waiting for everyone. This is now fixed

Wave 8: New dialogues to make it clearer to NOT kill the super jugg

items: Zath now has a chance to spawn Hazmite and Impalers for his mercenary.
When you kill Vin, Zath's crashout sequence has been adjusted for Impossible mode. He will now spawn an additional 6 more bombers and hazmites and an extra screaming eagle

Hazmites has been adjusted: Their mist now gradually increases BUT lasts longer
In impossible, their mist now lasts slightly longer AND increases in size faster
They still prioritize players BUT will be smart by targeting players who haven't been already targeted by Hazmites.

items: Fixed Mutual Greed giving the wrong value (+6% enemy HP instead of 9% enemy HP), Mutual Greed now gives +9% Wave Income instead of +3%

Altered Bomber's core rush timer varianc: Higher minimum time, lower maximum time
Removed Bombers having a 50% chance to rush the core anyways even after the timer expired, as it made them freak out and swap targets rapidly

items: Reduced regular detection range. (2500 -> 250)
Removed Headshot DMG handicaps on IMPOSSIBLE+, CW (HARD)+, DIV (HARD)+ (Handicaps against bosses still exist)
Removed target predictions for Zombie Combat Cars (ZCC)

Removed the queue system entirely for the achievement loading. The cache itself is already efficient and fast and the queue system has done nothing but cause issues by killing servers with infinite loading badges so it has been removed until further notice (most likely gone forever)
Yes, this is the reason why your badges never load. Which thankfully is deprecated now.

Fixed General Zath personally using his: This is what made him hard lock onto Jorg and Sky Terror
